info.name: World Air Quality Index (WAQI) JSON Feed Map API
Get monitoring stations within geographic bounds

params.name: latlng
params.description: Bounding box as a comma-separated string in the format: lat_north,lng_west,lat_south,lng_east.

params.name: networks
params.description: Filter results by monitoring network (e.g., 'all' for all networks).

items.docs: Returns all monitoring stations within a specified rectangular geographic bounding box, suitable for map display. Supports filtering by network (network parameter).
